hypotheses.reasoning: At 11:52:05 order-service hot-reloaded config revision 692, changing PAYMENT_SVC_URL to http://payment-svc.internal:9090 (#2216). From 11:52:57 onward, every order-service call to payment-svc fails with connection refused (#2325, #2377, #2480, #2577). Checkout fails upstream: order-service returns 503 to api-gateway, which produces the POST /checkout 503s and the 0% success alert. payment-svc logs no errors and shows normal charges up to 11:52:58, so it is not crashing; the refusals point to a wrong endpoint/port in the new config. A bad_deploy reading (order-service v2.25.0 rollout at #2135, 25s before the reload) is possible, but the failures start at the config reload. The report-cron pandas failures and status-poller legacy-inventory timeouts are unrelated noise.

verdict.recommendedAction: Revert order-service's PAYMENT_SVC_URL to the previous known-good value (or roll config-service back to revision 691), and confirm the correct payment-svc address and port, since 10.25.9.90:9090 refuses connections. Then verify order-service /charge calls succeed and POST /checkout returns 200. Check whether v2.25.0 also needs rollback. Fix the report-cron image (missing pandas) separately.
